title: Campfire Safezone
description: Creates a zone where mobs cannot spawn and applies regeneration to any non-hostile mobs. (read desc)
body:
Safe zone campfires

--What is it?--
This is a server plugin that creates a 75 block zone around LIT campfires that
-prevent mob spawning
-turns mobs into cats if they walk into the zone
-gives regeneration to non hostile entities.

--Commands--
This plugin only has 1 command as of now, which is /safezone particles on/off

--installation--
just put the .jar file into your plugins folder in your server.

--Compatibility--
Right now this plugin only works for Paper and Spigot
It MAY or MAY NOT work with CraftBukkit, it is untested. If it works for CraftBukkit, the optimizations will be far slower because everything was programmed to be super quick on Paper.

--Extra--
this plugin is extremely basic, I will read any comments about the plugin to make it as good as possible.
